'''Mes Cavoli''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

Training [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] once spent some [[Time/Legends|time]] there with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first]] battle of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
